description: Servitudes de passage des piétons sur le littoral (catégorie EL9) sur le département des Pyrénées-Atlantiques is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoh.conterra. This lot contains the data sets (plates and generators) relating to the passage of pedestrians along the coast in the coastal municipalities of the Pyrénées-Atlantiques. (Anglet, Biarritz, Bidart, Ciboure, Guéthary, Hendaye, Saint Jean de Luz, Urrugne). Attached are the decrees delimiting the maritime public domain. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Map visualization service (WMS) of the dataset: Pedestrian passage services on the coast (category EL9) in the departmen" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include WMS 1.1.1, WMS 1.3.0. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2020-01-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
